title: Prince Harry on grief after Princess Diana's death: 'I felt disloyal and guilty for the possibility of being happy'
summary: Prince Harry opened up about the grief he carried after losing his mother, Princess Diana, revealing how he once believed that being happy without her meant he was being disloyal to her memory.
